name: hud_ui_triplet_is_local_player_first_entry
description: HudUiTriplet::IsLocalPlayerFirstEntry reports empty scoreboard state or whether the first scoreboard entry belongs to the local network player.
known_limits: VC5 target hud_ui_triplet_is_local_player_first_entry currently fails with 52 unmasked byte mismatches after masking 4 relocation bytes; tier S remains blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ea60 validates computing the entry count from entries.begin/end, returning -1 when the count is zero, and otherwise comparing zNetwork_GetLocalPlayerKey() with the first entry playerKey to return 1 or 0.
Native smoke zhud_triplet_is_local_player_first_entry_smoke verifies null empty entries, non-null empty range, matching first player key, and nonmatching second-entry local key behavior.
